title: 第25章 初显峥嵘
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
一时间。

    场上的气氛凝固下来。

    段耀辉嘴里的药剂险些呛出来，连忙捂住嘴，瞪大了眼睛。

    冯曦也抬起头，愣在原地，一脸错愕。

    柳毅更是懵了足足两三秒。

    实际上，

    他之所以会对陈峰展现出恶意，一方面是为了向冯曦表忠心。

    另一方面，也是因为陈峰这个人，向来沉默寡言，从不惹事，很容易拿捏的样子。

    但他完全没想到，

    这个平日里少言寡语，甚至感觉有些懦弱的陈峰，面对自己的挑衅，反击会来的这么刚猛而直接。

    而对面的陈峰则一脸平静。

    说实话。

    如果是半个月之前，他体质刚过十三，而柳毅的体质已经达到十四。

    陈峰自知打不过对方，面对这种挑衅，他可能会选择无视，当做没看见。

    但现在？

    不好意思。

    蛇杀术Lv.2。

    体质14.5。

    没学《蛇杀术》之前我忍了，学了《蛇杀术》之后我还得忍着，那我这《蛇杀术》不是白学了？！

    半晌。

    柳毅才回过神来，脸色瞬间铁青。

    “你——”

    这时。

    训练室的大门猛地被推开，打断了他的话。

    梁越走了进来。

    一身蓝色运动外套，文件夹，脚步不急不缓。

    他一进门就注意到了训练室里不对劲的气氛。

    四个人各站一边，柳毅脸色铁青，陈峰站在原地一动不动，面无表情，段耀辉在旁边一脸尴尬地捏着空瓶子。

    梁越不动声色地扫了两人一眼，也没有多问。

    武道生毕竟是习武的，再加上年轻气盛，有点摩擦，太常见了。

    只要不影响正事儿，他都懒得管。

    他转头看向陈峰，开口道：

    “省赛指导组那边，要求各班把参赛选手的近期训练情况报上去。”

    “冯曦、柳毅、段耀辉，这段时间跟着我训练，进度我都有记录。”

    “就是陈峰你，一直在校外练，我不清楚你的情况。”

    梁越翻开文件夹。

    “所以今天让你来，就是给你测一下，主要看两项，体质和格斗水平，体质直接上仪器，格斗的话……”

    他顿了一下，扫了在场几人一圈。

    “找个人切磋一场，我看看你的实战水平。”

    话音落下。

    训练室里安静了一会儿。

    随后。

    段耀辉轻咳一声，当即把空药瓶往旁边一丢，搓了搓手。

    “我来吧梁导，反正闲着也是闲着。”
content_en:
For a while.

    The atmosphere on the field solidified.

    Duan Yaohui almost choked on the potion in his mouth, and quickly covered his mouth, eyes widening.

    Feng Xi also raised his head and froze on the spot, with a look of astonishment on his face.

    Liu Yi was stunned for two or three seconds.

    Actually,

    The reason why he showed malice toward Chen Feng was, on the one hand, to show his loyalty to Feng Xi.

    On the other hand, it is also because Chen Feng has always been taciturn, never causes trouble, and is easy to manipulate.

    But he didn't expect it at all,

    Chen Feng, who usually rarely talks and even feels a little cowardly, would fight back so fiercely and directly when faced with his own provocation.

    Opposite him, Chen Feng looked calm.

    to be honest.

    If it was half a month ago, his physique was just over thirteen, while Liu Yi's physique had already reached fourteen.

    Chen Feng knows that he can't defeat the opponent. Faced with this kind of provocation, he may choose to ignore it and pretend that he doesn't see it.

    But now?

    Excuse me.

    Snake Killing Technique Lv.2.

    Physical fitness 14.5.

    I endured it before learning the "Snake Killing Technique", and I still have to endure it after learning the "Snake Killing Technique", so didn't I learn the "Snake Killing Technique" in vain? !

    A long while.

    Only then did Liu Yi come back to his senses, and his face instantly turned livid.

    "You——"

    At this time.

    The door to the training room was pushed open suddenly, interrupting his words.

    Liang Yue walked in.

    Wearing a blue sports coat and a folder, he walked slowly and slowly.

    As soon as he entered the door, he noticed something wrong in the atmosphere in the training room.

    The four people stood on one side, Liu Yi's face was ashen, Chen Feng stood motionless and expressionless, and Duan Yaohui was holding an empty bottle with an embarrassed look on his side.

    Liang Yue glanced at the two of them calmly and didn't ask any more questions.

    After all, martial arts students are practicing martial arts, and because they are young and energetic, it is very common for them to have some friction.

    As long as it doesn't affect business, he doesn't bother to care.

    He turned to look at Chen Feng and said:

    "The provincial competition guidance team requires each class to report the recent training status of the contestants."

    "Feng Xi, Liu Yi, and Duan Yaohui have been training with me during this period, and I have recorded their progress."

    "It's you, Chen Feng, who has been practicing outside school. I don't know your situation."

    Liang Yue opened the folder.

    "So I asked you to come here today to give you a test. It mainly looks at two items, physical fitness and fighting level. Physical fitness is directly put on the instrument. If you are fighting..."

    He paused and glanced around the people present.

    "Find someone to spar and let me see your actual combat level."

    The words fell.

    The training room was quiet for a while.

    Subsequently.

    Duan Yaohui coughed lightly, immediately threw the empty medicine bottle aside and rubbed his hands.

    "Let me do it, Director Liang, I have nothing to do anyway."
title_en: Chapter 25 The first appearance of success
